# Theme / UI tools

6 tools. Not registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`; ask for it by name with `GODOT_MCP_CATEGORIES=theme`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `create_theme`

Create a new empty Theme resource and save it as a .tres file. Optionally set a default font and default font size. Returns an error if the file already exists unless overwrite is true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `theme_path` | `string` | yes | Project-relative path where the theme will be saved, e.g. 'res://theme/my_theme.tres' |
| `overwrite` | `boolean` | — | Set to true to replace an existing theme file. Defaults to false to prevent accidental data loss. |
| `default_font` | `string` | — | Optional path to the default font resource, e.g. 'res://fonts/MyFont.ttf' |
| `default_font_size` | `integer` | — | Optional default font size in pixels (e.g. 16) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/16-theme.json`, test TH-01:

```json
{
  "theme_path": "res://test_theme.tres",
  "overwrite": true
}
```

## `set_theme_color`

Set a named color override for a specific Control type in a Theme file. Common examples: set 'font_color' on 'Label', 'font_hover_color' on 'Button'. Saves the theme immediately.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `theme_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the .tres Theme file, e.g. 'res://theme/my_theme.tres' |
| `theme_type` | `string` | yes | Control class name this color applies to, e.g. 'Button', 'Label', 'LineEdit' |
| `color_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the color property, e.g. 'font_color', 'font_hover_color', 'font_disabled_color' |
| `color` | `string` | yes | Color value as hex string ('#rrggbb' or '#rrggbbaa') or as an [r, g, b] array with values 0–1 |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/16-theme.json`, test TH-03:

```json
{
  "theme_path": "res://test_theme.tres",
  "theme_type": "Button",
  "color_name": "font_color",
  "color": "#ff0000"
}
```

## `set_theme_font`

Assign a font resource to a named font slot for a specific Control type in a Theme file. Optionally set the font size for that slot. Saves the theme immediately.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `theme_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the .tres Theme file |
| `theme_type` | `string` | yes | Control class name, e.g. 'Button', 'Label' |
| `font_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the font slot, e.g. 'font' (the default slot for most Controls) |
| `font_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the font resource, e.g. 'res://fonts/MyFont.ttf' or 'res://fonts/MyFont.tres' |
| `font_size` | `integer` | — | Optional font size in pixels for this slot |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/16-theme.json`, test TH-05b:

```json
{
  "theme_path": "res://test_theme.tres",
  "theme_type": "Button",
  "font_name": "font",
  "font_path": "res://nonexistent_font.ttf"
}
```

## `set_theme_constant`

Set an integer constant override for a specific Control type in a Theme file. Constants control spacing, icon sizes, and other integer properties. Saves the theme immediately.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `theme_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the .tres Theme file |
| `theme_type` | `string` | yes | Control class name, e.g. 'Button', 'ItemList', 'Tree' |
| `constant_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the constant, e.g. 'outline_size', 'h_separation', 'v_separation', 'icon_max_width' |
| `value` | `integer` | yes | Integer value for the constant |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/16-theme.json`, test TH-04:

```json
{
  "theme_path": "res://test_theme.tres",
  "theme_type": "Button",
  "constant_name": "outline_size",
  "value": 2
}
```

## `set_stylebox`

Create and assign a StyleBox to a named slot for a specific Control type in a Theme file. Use 'flat' for colored/bordered boxes, 'line' for a single divider line, 'empty' for invisible padding. Saves the theme immediately.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `theme_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the .tres Theme file |
| `theme_type` | `string` | yes | Control class name, e.g. 'Button', 'PanelContainer', 'TabContainer' |
| `stylebox_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the StyleBox slot, e.g. 'normal', 'hover', 'pressed', 'disabled', 'panel', 'focus' |
| `stylebox_type` | `string` | — | 'flat' (default) — solid box with optional border, corners, shadow. 'line' — single-pixel divider. 'empty' — invisible, used for padding. One of: `"flat"`, `"line"`, `"empty"`. |
| `properties` | `object` | — | StyleBox properties to set. For 'flat': bg_color, border_color, border_width (all sides), border_width_left/right/top/bottom, corner_radius (all corners), corner_radius_top_left/top_right/bottom_left/bottom_right, draw_center, anti_aliased, shadow_color, shadow_size, shadow_offset ([x,y]), expand_margin (all sides), expand_margin_left/right/top/bottom. For 'line': color, thickness, vertical. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/16-theme.json`, test TH-05:

```json
{
  "theme_path": "res://test_theme.tres",
  "theme_type": "Button",
  "stylebox_name": "normal",
  "stylebox_type": "flat",
  "properties": {
    "bg_color": "#334455"
  }
}
```

## `get_theme_info`

Return all overrides defined in a Theme file, organized by Control type. Shows colors, fonts, font sizes, integer constants, and StyleBox names/types. Use this to inspect a theme before modifying it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `theme_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the .tres Theme file, e.g. 'res://theme/my_theme.tres' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/16-theme.json`, test TH-06:

```json
{
  "theme_path": "res://test_theme.tres"
}
```
